name: El Cuervo de Sevilla (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, white and light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Cuervo de Sevilla (a wheel and a raven on white above green).
history: Municipal flag of El Cuervo de Sevilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
